entries.summary: MMMU documents evaluation code and datasets for multidisciplinary multimodal understanding and reasoning, including MMMU-Pro. Its questions combine images and college-level subject knowledge rather than targeting coding tasks alone.
entries.selection_context: Compare the official benchmark tasks, data splits and evaluation pipeline when assessing multimodal models. The README distinguishes official local test-set evaluation from the community-maintained EvalScope workflow.
entries.limitations: Keep the dataset version, split, prompts and scoring protocol fixed when comparing results. Review dataset licensing and contamination risks. Published scores and benchmark coverage were not independently reproduced.
entries.decision: Retain the published route as a dated unranked reference when absent from the current discovery snapshot.
